identity.title: Verify EverRun semantic projection after export fix

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Using the same raw package accepted by 8065, verify that source-proven lifecycle, execution-control decisions, validation and scope facts project into canonical Ailuros fields instead of false unknowns. Do not add new semantics; only fix deterministic projection/conformance defects proven by this sample.
human_pressure.why_now: The previous dogfood showed syntactically importable evidence can still be semantically useless. This pack separates producer correctness from Ailuros projection correctness.
do_not_misread: Do not require every EverRun-private event type to become canonical.
Do not infer authority/approval/budget when the producer did not provide them.
red_lines: No EverRun-specific branch in core evaluation semantics.

machine_core.goal: Prove canonical projection consumes the producer's source-proven terminal, decision, validation and scope semantics correctly and source-neutrally.
red_lines: Do not broaden accepted event semantics beyond evidence-backed mappings.
invariants: run_completed/run_failed drives lifecycle only when present as authoritative run-level evidence.
governance_decision with explicit execution_control domain projects to execution_control without guessing.
Missing authority/approval/budget remains unknown or not-applicable only according to existing evidence semantics.

producer.artifact: canonical events imported from the 8065 raw package

observable_effect.assertion: Source-proven lifecycle, decision, validation and scope facts no longer collapse to unknown solely due to field-shape mismatch.

proofs.assertion: Focused tests cover only defects reproduced by the real sample and full suite passes.

failure_semantics: If the source lacks the fact, retain unknown.
If the source provides a canonical fact and projection still returns unknown, classify as consumer defect.
If fixing requires producer identity checks, reject the approach.

steps.title: Capture actual post-fix payload shapes
details: Inspect only the accepted 8065 package and existing canonical contracts.
Record exact keys and values for run terminal, governance_decision, project_validation and project_scope events.

steps.title: Compare against current projection semantics
details: Determine which facts already project correctly and which remain false unknowns.
Do not modify code for already-correct paths.

steps.title: Fix only reproduced consumer defects
details: Make the smallest source-neutral projection change required by actual evidence.
Prefer existing canonical event fields over producer identity or free-text inference.

steps.title: Prove focused and full regression
details: Add or tighten tests for each reproduced defect.
Run focused projection tests and full suite.

acceptance: Source-proven lifecycle projects terminal state correctly.
Source-proven validation and scope are not false unknowns.
Missing unrelated governance dimensions remain conservative.

must_check: 8065 raw acceptance succeeded or its exact blocking evidence is used.
Every code change maps to a reproduced real-sample defect.
reject_if: The implementation branches on source == everrun or equivalent producer identity.
Free-text reason fields are used to invent canonical semantics.
Missing governance facts are promoted to clean/evaluated.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Projection correctness only; semantic surface is frozen.
